QuestInfo.name: [Aqua Road] A Witch's Touch
QuestInfo.0: You ask Carta the Sea Witch about the broken flashlight. Will she be able to help?
QuestInfo.1: Carta doesn't want to get involved, but has her interest piqued by the note Wiz restored and the picture Han was able to save. Out of caution, she asks to see the flashlight.
QuestInfo.2: You handed the broken flashlight to Carta. She began casting a spell on it.
